text: Handling deadlines starts with good time management. Break large tasks into smaller steps and give each step a clear deadline. Prioritization is also key: decide which tasks are most urgent and important, and do those first. If you have too much work, try scope management. Talk with your manager or team about reducing what you need to deliver. Never hide a problem. Communication is essential. Tell people early if you may miss a deadline, and explain why. This gives everyone time to find a solution. With planning and honest communication, you can manage deadlines more calmly and avoid unnecessary stress.
